_what: Overnight run snapshot. The firing cron copies this into run_request.json and pushes.
_desc: A3 — the frozen tweak contract. luna and qwen3-235b, the eleven informative probes, n=25.
_frozen_by: the signer, teacherbot@blue, 2026-07-31, with one amendment: drop opus.
_contract: Read the balance first. Stop if the credits are gone.
Sort the dispatch order by price. Put the cheapest model first.
Run luna and qwen3-235b. Do not run grok.
Use n=25 for each cell. Do not add more models.
Run only the probes with 1 to 24 passes of 25. Skip the other probes.
Set the ceiling to a loss you accept. Do not set it to an estimate.
Report a pass count of 25 for each probe. Do not report a threshold verdict.
_probe_selection: The eleven probes where luna scored between 1 and 24 of 25 in run 30673119035. Excluded at 25/25: P2, P2S, P10, P16. Excluded at 0/25: P14, P17, P18. A probe pinned at either end returns no information about variance and no information about a second model's position relative to luna's boundary.
_qwen_caveat: The eleven were chosen from luna's profile, not qwen's, because qwen has no n=25 run. This was declared as the weakest joint in the contract when it was put to the gate. If qwen pins at 0 or 25 on several of them, that is a finding about the selection, not about qwen.
_ceiling_is_a_loss_not_an_estimate: $1.50. The cost model erred 22% low on A1 and 184% high on A2, so it is not used to set this. $1.50 is what can be lost without touching the $5.50 cap ($2.6218 headroom) or the read balance ($3.6981). On the measured per-cell basis from A2, 550 cells should land near $0.28.
